File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Fix the scheduler calculation for weekly cadences so that a schedule created on the day of the week it is meant to run (e.g. Monday) schedules its first run for today or properly accounts for the current day rather than skipping straight to the following week.
args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week when created on run day
